questions.question: Someone pressures you to try a drug. Which response sets a clear boundary?
choices: Saying no clearly and leaving the situation
Accepting it because a friend offered it
Letting the group decide for you

questions.question: A friend is worried about their substance use. Which response offers support?
choices: Sharing their concern with the whole group
Listening without judgment and helping them reach a trusted adult
Telling them they must handle it alone
